test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following dancers won the prestigious Padma Shree award in the year 2021, for her contribution to folk dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Matha B Manjamma Jogathi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Matha B Manjamma Jogathi** is a renowned **folk dancer** from **Karnataka**.
 
• She was honored with the **Padma Shri award** in the year **2021** for her significant contributions to **folk dance**.
 
• She is particularly known for her performance of the traditional **Jogathi Nritya**, a folk dance dedicated to the goddess **Yellamma**.
 
• Her journey as a transgender dancer has inspired many and brought attention to the rich heritage of folk arts in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Amubi Singh**__

 __
 
• **Amubi Singh** is known for his contributions to **Manipuri dance**.
 
• Manipuri dance is one of the **classical dance forms** of India, originating from the state of **Manipur**.
 
 
 
• **Kumudini Lakhia**__
 __
 
• **Kumudini Lakhia** is a prominent **Kathak dancer** and choreographer.
 
• She has made significant contributions to the **Kathak dance form** and is known for her innovative approach to the traditional dance style.
 
 
 
• **Teejan Bai**__
 
 
• **Teejan Bai** is a renowned **Pandavani singer** from Chhattisgarh.
 
• Pandavani is a traditional performing art form that involves **narration of tales from the Mahabharata** with musical accompaniment.
